create_ProgramNode: create a ProgramNode with children, sequence segments, and energy function terms for protein representation
build_ProgramNode_tree: build a tree of ProgramNode instances to represent multimer protein chains with energy weights
get_sequence_and_set_residue_index_range: get the full amino acid sequence and residue index ranges from a ProgramNode tree
get_energy_term_functions: get all energy term functions with weights and names from a ProgramNode for folding optimization
mutate_ProgramNode: mutate a ProgramNode tree by probabilistically selecting a child based on mutation candidate counts
